task: Create a JSON configuration file for an AWS Lambda function that processes S3 events, with environment variables for the target bucket and log level
solution_criteria: Must include Lambda function metadata (name, runtime, role ARN)
Must contain an S3 event source mapping configuration
Must include environment variables for target bucket name and log level
Must specify valid AWS Lambda runtime (e.g., python3.11)
Must include proper JSON syntax and structure

task: Write a Python function that validates an AWS IAM policy document by checking if it contains at least one Principal, Effect, and Action statement, then returns True or False
solution_criteria: Function must accept a dictionary or JSON string as input
Must check for presence of 'Principal', 'Effect', and 'Action' keys
Must handle both valid and invalid policy structures gracefully
Should work with nested Statement arrays in IAM policies

task: Create a regular expression pattern that matches valid AWS S3 bucket names according to AWS naming rules (3-63 characters, lowercase letters, numbers, hyphens, must start and end with lowercase letter or number)
solution_criteria: Must enforce length constraint of 3-63 characters
Must only allow lowercase letters (a-z), numbers (0-9), and hyphens (-)
Must require the name to start with a lowercase letter or number
Must require the name to end with a lowercase letter or number
Must not allow consecutive hyphens or hyphens at start/end
Should be a single regex pattern that can be compiled and tested
